site_name: AWS Asia Pacific (Jakarta) Region
notes: Region launched 14 Dec 2021. AWS estimates US$5bn (IDR 71tn) over 15 years, covering construction, operating costs and local purchases (company estimate, includes opex). AZ count and MW not in release. Province not disclosed, so no coordinates.

site_name: Google Cloud Jakarta region (asia-southeast2)
notes: Three-zone region live about 24 Jun 2020, Google's 24th region and the first hyperscale cloud region in Indonesia. No investment or site disclosed.

site_name: Microsoft Indonesia Central cloud region
notes: Three availability zones, live around 27 May 2025. Capex is the US$1.7bn 2024 to 2028 pledge (Microsoft release 30 Apr 2024), which also funds AI skilling for 840,000 people, so it overstates building spend. Region first announced 25 Feb 2021 under Microsoft's Berdayakan Ekonomi Digital Indonesia initiative, with a 100% renewable supply goal by 2025 (Microsoft release).

site_name: Alibaba Cloud Indonesia region (3 data centres)
notes: First Indonesian DC built 2018, second 2019, third planned for early 2021 (Alibaba release, Jul 2020). DCD (Jan 2025) says Alibaba operates three DCs in Indonesia. Sites, MW and spend not disclosed. Alibaba holds a GoTo stake and signed a five-year cloud deal with GoTo (Sep 2024).

site_name: Tencent Cloud Jakarta region (3 data centres)
anchor_tenant: Tencent Cloud (own); GoTo as major customer
notes: Tencent release (Nov 2025): a third Jakarta data centre added in 2025. DCD/Structure Research: US$500m more to 2030 for the third DC, announced Jan 2025 at the Indonesia-China Business Forum; capex = that pledge only. GoTo migrated on-demand services to Tencent Cloud (Jun 2025). Opening years of the first two Jakarta DCs not verified here, so blank.

site_name: Huawei Cloud Indonesia region (Jakarta, 3 AZ)
notes: Region launched 23 Nov 2022 in Jakarta with US$300m over five years (Huawei release). W.Media: the 3AZ facility was built in 37 days, supported by local unit Sparkoo Technologies Indonesia. Jakarta Post (3 Dec 2025): three AZs about 91% used, fourth AZ due 2026 (no amount or MW).

site_name: Princeton Digital Group BT1 Batam campus (Nongsa Digital Park)
notes: PDG announced 20 Feb 2023 a 96MW campus of four buildings (up to 24MW each) on 15 acres in Nongsa Digital Park, first project of its SG+ strategy. Capex is the 'close to US$1bn' SG+ initial plan, which also covers Johor, so it overstates Batam. Datacentermap lists BT1 (24MW, Jl. Teluk Mata Ikan) as under construction with Phase 1 once scheduled for 2024. Coordinates are Nongsa district centre (Wikipedia), not the site.

site_name: DayOne Nongsa Digital Park campus (NDP, 3 buildings)
notes: Three DCs, about 72MW combined, co-developed with sovereign fund INA (its first DC deal); DBS and UOB lent IDR 6.7tn (about US$411m), completion targeted end-2025 (W.Media 6 Jun 2025). Capex = loan only. Baxtel: GDS bought the NDP land Nov 2021; Bldg1 and Bldg2 operational, Bldg3 (38MW) under construction; DayOne 34MW operational in Batam. Stack Mixed because DayOne was spun out of China's GDS; tenants undisclosed. Coordinates are Nongsa district centre.

site_name: DayOne Kabil Industrial Tech Park (KITP) hyperscale campus
notes: DayOne's second Batam campus in Kabil Integrated Industrial Estate. MW is grid supply: 511MVA (about 450MW) PPA with PLN Batam, phased 2026 to 2027, called Indonesia's largest long-term PPA; IT capacity not disclosed. Jakarta Post partner content (20 Apr 2026) adds up to 200MWp solar. Baxtel lists KITP at 240MW, construction/planned. Status Under construction per Baxtel; not confirmed by DayOne. Kabil lies in Nongsa district; coordinates are the district centre.

site_name: Firmus Nvidia DGX AI Factory, Batam (built by DayOne)
anchor_tenant: Nvidia (supplier and Firmus investor); multi-tenant enterprise customers
notes: 360MW Nvidia DGX AI Factory campus, multi-tenant, operations from Q1 2027; partnership expected to yield US$25bn to 30bn of contracted purchases over six years; Nvidia to give access to up to 170,000 accelerators in 2027 to 2028 via revenue-sharing. Site within Batam not stated; it may sit on DayOne's Kabil campus (unconfirmed), so MW may overlap the KITP row. Stack US because the hardware and anchor partner is Nvidia. Status inferred from 'is building'.

site_name: BW Digital NDP-1 (Nongsa Digital Park)
notes: DataCenterNews Asia (21 Nov 2025): NDP-1 is 144MW, AI-oriented, linked to Singapore by the Nongsa-Changi cable built with Telin. Sizes conflict: datacentermap says 120MW planned IT, Q4 2025 target, land bought Mar 2024; Baxtel shows 24MW under construction/operational. Status set to Under construction as a middle reading; Medium confidence. Coordinates are Nongsa district centre.

site_name: NeutraDC Nxera Batam (Kabil)
owner_investors: Telkom Indonesia (majority via NeutraDC); Singtel (Nxera); Medco Power Indonesia
notes: Groundbreaking 22 Dec 2022 for a 51MW, three-phase campus on 8ha in Kabil (W.Media); Telkom majority, Singtel and Medco minority. Construction began Jun 2024; topped off Oct 2025 with Tier III design cert; 18MW at launch scalable to 54MW; Rp1.4tn (about US$85m) over five years; PLN Batam power deal for 2025 to 2028. Bisnis (Dec 2022) gave Rp3.08tn for the original plan. Coordinates are Nongsa district centre.

site_name: DCI Indonesia H1 campus Cibitung (JK1 to JK6)
owner_investors: DCI Indonesia (listed; Salim Group and founders)
notes: DCI release: JK6 (36MW, AI-ready) launched 3 Jun 2025 on the H1 campus in Cibitung; DCI total 119MW across three locations. Campus MW not given separately, so left blank. Opening years of earlier JK buildings not verified here, so left blank. Coordinates are Cibitung district centre (Wikipedia).

site_name: DCI Indonesia H2 campus Karawang (Pertiwi Lestari)
owner_investors: DCI Indonesia (Salim Group 11.2% per The Tech Capital)
notes: DCD: first phase H2-01 (15MW, 3,000 racks) soft-opened; campus planned to 600MW IT on 791ha (The Tech Capital says 86ha site in Pertiwi Lestari estate; figures conflict). Two tenants reported; solar supply planned. DCD later reported a second H2 building. Dates not stated in the pages opened, so years left blank. MW is full build-out, not live capacity. No sourced coordinates.

site_name: Equinix JK1 Jakarta (Equinix-Astra JV)
notes: Inaugurated 15 May 2025 in Jakarta's CBD; 550 cabinets in phase one, 1,600 at full build; about US$74m planned spend announced 2022. JV with Astra (Equinix release Apr 2023); split not stated. MW not disclosed.

site_name: DAMAC Digital (Edgnex) Jakarta AI campus, GIIC Cikarang
notes: US$2.3bn, 144MW design IT load, land bought Mar 2025, phase 1 due Dec 2026, target PUE 1.32 (Developing Telecoms 18 Jun 2025). Baxtel places it at Jalan GIIC Boulevard, Sukamahi, Cikarang Pusat. Coordinates are Central Cikarang district centre (Wikipedia).

site_name: Digital Edge GIIC Bekasi hyperscale campus (500MW)
notes: Announced 29 Jan 2026: US$4.5bn, 500MW IT at full build (scalable to 1GW) at GIIC estate, Bekasi. Phase one is three buildings due Q4 2026, Q1 2027 and Q2 2027. Fibre via Indonet, Digital Edge's Indonesian subsidiary. Status Under construction is inferred from delivery dates. Coordinates are Central Cikarang district centre.

site_name: STT Jakarta 1 (Bekasi)
notes: First STT GDC facility in Indonesia, up to 19.5MW IT on 18,000 sqm, first building of a campus, launched about Jun 2023. JV of Triputra Group and Temasek per W.Media. No sourced coordinates.

site_name: EdgeConneX Greater Jakarta campus (JKT01)
notes: Grand opening 13 Sep 2023 of a 120MW Jakarta campus in Bekasi Regency; EdgeConneX entered Indonesia by buying GTN Data Center (W.Media headline). Capex is US$403.8m of sustainability-linked financing, not total spend. Live MW not stated; 120MW is campus plan.

site_name: NTT Jakarta 3 Data Center (Bekasi)
notes: Launched 1 Apr 2022 in Bekasi, about 30km from central Jakarta: 15.2MW critical IT, scalable to 45MW. Antara (2019) reported plans for a 45MW campus. No sourced coordinates.

site_name: BDx Indonesia CGK4 AI campus, Jatiluhur
owner_investors: BDx Data Centers; Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison; Lintasarta
anchor_tenant: Nvidia platform for sovereign AI phase 1
notes: Phase 1 completed Aug 2024; campus scalable to 500MW, billed renewable-powered (source not named). DCD cites 70MW on the company site. Dec 2024 (Antara/Business Wire): CGK4 hosts what partners call Indonesia's first sovereign AI data centre on Nvidia accelerated computing. BDx HQ (Hong Kong) is background knowledge, not from the pages opened. Coordinates are Purwakarta Regency reference point (Wikipedia), not the site.

site_name: Indosat-Nvidia AI Center of Excellence, Solo Technopark
owner_investors: Indosat; Nvidia (reported); Surakarta city (ownership after 15 years)
notes: About US$200m reported (Reuters via DCD, Apr 2024), but Indosat said the figure is unverified and may include GPUs. Groundbreaking planned 2025, use by 2027, build-transfer to Surakarta city after 15 years. No confirmation of construction found; status Announced. Coordinates are Surakarta city (bamwor.com), town precision.

site_name: Princeton Digital Group Cibitung campus (JC1 and JC2)
notes: JC2 (22MW) opened Sep 2023 next to JC1 on a 19,550 sqm campus; campus total 35MW (Intelligent CIO, 31 Aug 2021, when JC2 was announced; PDG put about US$150m on it per Capacity headline, not opened). W.Media (7 May 2026) places JC1 and JC2 in the MM100 [sic] industrial area, Cibitung, 35km from central Jakarta. year_announced refers to JC2. Coordinates are Cibitung district centre.

site_name: Princeton Digital Group JC3 campus (GIIC)
notes: 120MW campus under development (W.Media 7 May 2026, reporting PDG's US$856m debt raise for Indonesia expansion; debt not split by site so capex blank). Location inferred from JC4 article (JC4 sits about 1.7km from JC3 in GIIC). Coordinates are Central Cikarang district centre.

site_name: Princeton Digital Group JC4 (GIIC, 240MW powered land)
notes: Announced 30 Apr 2026: 240MW powered land in GIIC, four 60MW buildings. PDG says Indonesia portfolio reaches 400MW with JC4. Coordinates are Central Cikarang district centre.

site_name: Digital Edge EDGE1 Jakarta (Indonet)
operator: Digital Edge (via PT Indointernet Tbk / Indonet)
notes: Central Jakarta carrier hotel with 1,200 racks and 6MW IT; hosts IIX and EPIX exchanges (Digital Edge site). Digital Edge bought control of Indonet in 2021. Opening year not stated.

site_name: Digital Edge EDGE2 Jakarta (Kuningan)
notes: Ready for service 28 Feb 2024 on Jl. Kuningan Mulia: 23MW IT, over 3,400 racks, under 3km from EDGE1. The page labels it both South and Central Jakarta.

site_name: NeutraDC Hyperscale Data Center Cikarang (HDC JKT-1)
notes: Building 1 IT capacity 21.5MW, fully occupied by Q4 2026 (KabarBursa 4 Nov 2026); NeutraDC targets 400MW over time and 1GW regional aspiration, exploring land recommended by Danantara. Tenants not named. Opening year not in source. Coordinates are Central Cikarang district centre.

site_name: NeutraDC Cikarang expansion (up to 200MW, PLN supply MoU)
notes: MoU with PLN signed 11 Aug 2026 in Bandung to secure power for gradual hyperscale build up to 200MW in Cikarang. No amount or dates. May overlap the 400MW target in the HDC JKT-1 row. Coordinates are Central Cikarang district centre.

site_name: Oracle Cloud Indonesia North (Batam) region
notes: OCI release note: Indonesia North (Batam), ap-batam-1, launched 15 May 2025 with one availability domain. The Edge Singapore (undated, citing people familiar) said Oracle would be sole tenant of DayOne data centres at Nongsa Digital Park, plots able to support at least 120MW; this hosting link is reported, not confirmed by Oracle. DCD (undated) earlier reported Oracle in talks with the government, with Nongsa Digital Park the favoured site.

site_name: Equator Gate System Batam AI data centre (RangeIDC)
notes: US$5bn AI data centre on 30ha in Nongsa backed by China's RangeIDC, its first overseas project; power agreement (described as both PPA and MoU) with PLN Batam signed late May 2026; BP Batam says it will fast-track. Bisnis headline gives Rp88tn. MW not stated; construction not started per W.Media. The Star (26 Sep 2026) lists 'Equator Gate System Batam (US$5bn)' among major projects. Chip supplier not disclosed; subject to US parent-company licence rule (May 2026). Coordinates are Nongsa district centre.

site_name: SM+ SMX01 Jakarta CBD data centre
owner_investors: SM+ (Sinar Mas); Korea Investment Real Asset Management (KIRA)
notes: Opened 2 Nov 2026 (W.Media): 21MW, AI-ready, owned and managed by SM+, with KIRA as investment partner and LG Sinar Mas (LG CNS and SM+ JV) as builder and operator. Jakarta Post: project first announced Sep 2024, groundbreaking 6 Mar 2025, US$300m (about Rp4.9tn), 18MW scalable to 60MW, completion H2 2026. MW conflict 18 vs 21 at opening.

site_name: K2 Data Centres JKT 1 (with Sinarmas Land)
notes: JV of Kuok Group's K2 and Sinarmas Land: 58.8MW IT at full build over four facilities in Bekasi Regency, first phase slated for early 2024, second campus planned in Karawang. DCD page undated; Edge Singapore puts SML's share close on 'Oct 17' (year not given). Live status not confirmed, so Under construction.

site_name: Pusat Data Nasional (PDN) 1 Cikarang
operator: Komdigi (Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs)
owner_investors: Government of Indonesia; French government G-to-G loan
notes: Built with a EUR 164.7m (Rp2.7tn) French G-to-G loan; provisional handover done by Apr 2025 (Indonesia Business Post). Opening slipped repeatedly from 2024; Bisnis headlines say not yet operating in Dec 2025 and limited operation from Jan 2026 (headlines only, not opened), hence Low. MW not disclosed. Coordinates are Central Cikarang district centre.

site_name: Pusat Data Nasional (PDN) Batam
notes: Komdigi's secretary general told parliament on 4 Feb 2025 the Batam national data centre would be dropped after Prabowo's budget cuts (Komdigi budget cut 58%) and the end of foreign-loan funding. Baxtel still lists a KOMDIGI Government Data Center in Batam as construction/planned. IKN site status undisclosed.

site_name: Indosat GPU cloud / AI factory, Jakarta (GB200 racks)
anchor_tenant: Reported tenant INF Tech (Shanghai); sovereign AI CoE users
notes: Per WSJ via Tom's Hardware: Indosat bought 32 Nvidia GB200 racks (about 2,300 GPUs, about US$100m) from Aivres, installed at its Jakarta site by Oct 2025, with compute rented to China's INF Tech; lawyers said it appeared legal and Nvidia said partners were cleared. Nvidia blog (Jul 2025): Indosat runs the Blackwell AI factory for Komdigi's AI Center of Excellence. Stack Mixed: US hardware, reported Chinese tenant. Capex is the reported rack value only. Exact building not disclosed.

site_name: Golden Digital Gateway data centre, Batam
notes: Only source opened is Baxtel's Batam market page, which lists the operator as Gaw Capital Partners with 20MW in construction/operational status. No press release opened; dates unknown.
